text.p: These were the headlines on Estonian Kuku radio at noon. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- Estonian and Finnish foreign ministers sign the visa free travel agreement between Estonia and Finland.
- Rescue services finished cleaning up Soviet military oil pollution the near the Paldiski dock.
- Estonians are the most optimistic about their financial future compared to other central and eastern Europeans, according to a study ordered by the European Commission.
